properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 24 at 3:13PM MDT until July 24 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Lee Burn Scar in...
Central Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...

* Until 615 PM MDT.

* At 313 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Lee Burn Scar. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in debris flows
moving through the burn scar. The debris flow can consist of rock,
mud, vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding in and around the Lee Burn
Scar.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around
the Lee Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
mainly rural areas of Central Rio Blanco County

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 24 at 3:12PM MDT until July 24 at 6:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Gold Mountain burn scar in...
East Central Ouray County in southwestern Colorado...

* Until 615 PM MDT.

* At 312 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Gold Mountain Burn Scar. Between 0.5 and 1
inch of rain has fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5 to 1
inch in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in debris flow
moving through Cow Creek. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud,
vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding in and around the Gold
Mountain Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around
the Gold Mountain Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
mainly rural areas of East Central Ouray County

properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern San Miguel County in southwestern Colorado...

* Until 600 PM MDT.

* At 255 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms
producing flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sawpit, Placerville and Fall Creek.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 24 at 2:37PM MDT until July 24 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible, flooding
caused by excessive rainfall over the Gold Mountain Fire Burn Scar
is possible.

* WHERE...Gold Mountain Fire Burn Scar in Ouray County Colorado,
including Dexter and Cutler Creek drainages and Highway 550.

* WHEN...Until 630 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Excessive rainfall is possible over the Gold Mountain
Burn Scar which could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and
other loose materials.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 235 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms in the area. If thunderstorms develop over the
Gold Mountain burn scar, debris flows are likely within
Cutler and Dexter Creek drainages, including Highway 550.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
